note:
r3 of the THIRD image in the /pages/brightening-glow set - templates/page.brightening-glow.json, section `content`, block `together` ('The Multi-Pathway Brightening System').

Malcolm, 2026-08-26: 'lets get them to look more like the medical skin diagrams on this page: https://www.skingenetix.com/pages/firming-skin-density. That style is better. And - lets show the activation in three different levels of the skin. lets make it clear that there are three different active benefits.'

=== THE STYLE IS TRANSCRIBED FROM THE TWO LIVE FIRMING DIAGRAMS, NOT PARAPHRASED ===

Both files were fetched from the live CDN at 2000px and read at full size:
  skingenetix-collagen-peptide-firming-skin-structure-diagram.jpg   (the approach frame)
  skingenetix-loss-of-skin-firmness-collagen-elastin-cross-section.jpg (the causes frame)

What they actually do, band by band, and what every slot below now specifies verbatim:
  1  quilted surface of soft rounded MATTE VELVETY pads, warm peach, packed side by side, slightly domed - matte is the point, everything else in the picture is glossy
  2  a thin cream-ivory film of fine parallel horizontal strands, laminated at the cut, slightly glossy
  3  a dense band of SMALL uniform glossy pale-pink spheres, tightly packed like caviar
  4  a thin flat salmon-peach plate, smooth and glossy, its thickness and a sliver of its top edge visible
  5  the tallest band: thick glossy CREAM-IVORY CABLES lying in loose horizontal waves, crossing over one another on a warm peach ground, pearlescent with long highlights
  6  a second thin salmon-peach plate
  7  two rows of large pearl-cream lobule spheres, glossy, varying sizes
  8  a thin CLEAR GLASS BASE PLATE that extends a little beyond the block at both ends

Delivery vocabulary in the firming approach frame: large glassy transparent spheres floating in the air above, some holding a diagonal chain of pearl beads; fine STRAIGHT WHITE BEAMS descending from them into the block; a bright STARBURST GLINT with radiating points where a beam arrives; small white sparkles scattered near the landing; a soft warm bloom on the surface where a sphere sits close. Ground is a smooth warm cream-blush gradient, high-key, soft diffuse light, no hard shadow.

THE BLOCK IS INSET IN BOTH REFERENCES with clear background to left and right, and every stratum terminates in a MODELLED end - rounded plate edges showing thickness, rounded cable tips, whole lobule spheres - never a flat slice. r1 said the block runs edge to edge and 17 of 20 candidates came back clipped; r2 inverted that and the usable yield went 15% -> 50%. The instruction stays inverted here.

=== THE THREE BENEFITS, AT THREE DIFFERENT DEPTHS - THIS IS THE POINT OF r3 ===

The copy lists three things and says they act 'at the same time'. So there are THREE separate spheres, THREE separate beams, and THREE separate landing points at three clearly different heights in the block. No beam passes through to the bottom; each stops at its own layer and makes its own glint there. A viewer should be able to count three.

  LEVEL 1  the quilted surface pads      HYDRATION & GLOW
           beam ends in the pad layer; pads plumped, taut, holding clear water droplets; bright specular sheen along the top so the surface reflects light
  LEVEL 2  the small-bead granular band  EVEN-LOOKING TONE
           beam ends in the bead band; soft translucent warm-brown pigment granules spread in a perfectly EVEN regular scatter, never clustered
  LEVEL 3  the deep cable zone           ANTIOXIDANT DEFENCE
           beam ends among the cables; fine dark grey angular motes breaking apart and fading where it lands

IT MUST NOT DEPICT PIGMENT BEING DESTROYED, lifted, bleached or erased. 'Even-looking tone' means the pigment is evenly DISTRIBUTED, not removed - the same quantity, spread evenly instead of clumped. Skin-lightening imagery would overclaim the copy and contradict the page's own FAQ answering 'Is glutathione safe for all skin tones?'. No face appears, so no tone comparison is possible.

NO LEFT-TO-RIGHT PROGRESSION. A gradient across the block reads as 'this end became that end' - a before-and-after wearing a gradient, the trap caught on the firming pair. The block is uniform across its width; the three events are separated by DEPTH, never by side.

Actives told apart by FORM, never colour: glutathione is a tripeptide, a chain of EXACTLY THREE pearl-white beads. Stable vitamin C is a single colourless faceted crystal. The hydration sphere holds clear colourless water droplets. Nothing is tinted, nothing metallic. GHK-Cu is deliberately NOT drawn as copper - metallic copper is barred on this store's anatomy diagrams and would read as a brand colour.

=== GEOMETRY ===

The `together` media box measured 660x660 at 1440 - SQUARE, unlike the causes block's 660x730 - so the master is square 2048x2048 and renders uncropped. The two published siblings put their block at 0.7905 of the frame width; this must match, hence 'about four fifths of the width' plus modelled ends.

CLASS B, no reference images - every selected explainer on this store was generated class B with the style carried in the prompt. All six suppliers, two candidates each. gpt-image ignored the inset instruction on all six of its r2 candidates; watch it. FLUX.2 renders printed graduation digits on glassware and there is a glass base plate here. Luma failed all three r2 slots with 'luma processing: None'. Remember `set -a` before sourcing credentials.

slots.title: A · Firming-diagram style, three beams landing at three different depths
slots.prompt:
Luxury medical explainer illustration for premium skincare, in the style of a high-end cosmetic-science cutaway: smooth glossy three-dimensional CGI, immaculate, high-key, lit by soft even diffuse light with no hard shadow. Square format. Warm peach, coral, blush and cream throughout, on a smooth warm cream-blush background gradient.

A rectangular block of skin in cross-section, SQUARE TO THE CAMERA - a straight-on front elevation, cut face exactly parallel to the picture plane, edges horizontal, no perspective and no turn, with at most the thinnest sliver of the top surface showing along its upper edge.

THE BLOCK DOES NOT TOUCH THE SIDES OF THE FRAME. It sits inset, about four fifths of the frame's width, clear background to its left and right. ITS LEFT AND RIGHT ENDS ARE FULLY MODELLED: every layer finishes in a rounded three-dimensional end face, never a flat slice - the thin plates end with a rounded edge showing their thickness and a sliver of their top, the cables end in smooth closed rounded tips, the lobules are whole rounded spheres. It stands on a THIN CLEAR GLASS PLATE that extends a little beyond the block at both ends.

THE LAYERS, TOP TO BOTTOM:
  1  a quilted surface of soft rounded MATTE VELVETY pads in warm peach, packed side by side, gently domed - matte and suede-like, while everything else in the picture is glossy
  2  a thin cream-ivory film of fine parallel horizontal strands, laminated where it is cut
  3  a dense band of SMALL uniform glossy pale-pink spheres packed tightly together like caviar
  4  a thin flat salmon-peach plate, smooth and glossy
  5  the tallest band: thick glossy CREAM-IVORY CABLES in loose horizontal waves crossing over one another on a warm peach ground, pearlescent with long soft highlights
  6  a second thin salmon-peach plate
  7  two rows of large pearl-cream spheres, glossy, of slightly varying sizes

FLOATING IN THE AIR ABOVE THE BLOCK ARE EXACTLY THREE LARGE GLASSY TRANSPARENT SPHERES, well separated from one another. From each sphere a single fine STRAIGHT WHITE BEAM of light descends into the block. THE THREE BEAMS STOP AT THREE CLEARLY DIFFERENT DEPTHS, and each ends in a bright STARBURST GLINT with fine radiating points and a scatter of small white sparkles around it. No beam continues past its own glint.

  THE FIRST SPHERE holds a cluster of small clear colourless water droplets. Its beam is the SHORTEST and stops in the quilted pad layer near the top. Around that glint the pads are swollen, plump and taut, holding clear glassy droplets, and a crisp bright specular sheen runs along the top of the surface so it visibly reflects light.

  THE SECOND SPHERE holds a short chain of EXACTLY THREE pearl-white beads. Its beam is MEDIUM LENGTH, passing down through the pads and the cream film and stopping in the band of small pink spheres. Around that glint, soft translucent warm-brown pigment granules are spread through the bead band in a completely EVEN, regular, uniform scatter - evenly spaced, the same everywhere across the whole width, never gathered into clusters or blotches.

  THE THIRD SPHERE holds a single small colourless faceted crystal. Its beam is the LONGEST, passing all the way down into the zone of cream-ivory cables and stopping there. Around that deepest glint, fine dark grey angular motes are breaking apart and fading away among the cables.

The block is uniform across its width - no end of it is healthier or duller than the other. Glossy, luminous, immaculate, calm and clinical.
